prompt:
Create Raidian / 电弧 neutral STANDING IDLE sprites matching the supplied walk-sheet character and exact painted chibi style. Reference is identity and scale/style; CHANGE WALKING TO STANDING STILL. Output ONE transparent SQUARE image with uniform invisible 4 columns x 4 rows grid, 16 complete separated chibi sprites. row2 cells: W normal, W breath, NW normal, NW breath.
row3 cells: N normal, N breath, NE normal, NE breath.
row4 cells: E normal, E breath, SE normal, SE breath.
S faces front viewer; SW down-left front three-quarter; W left profile; NW up-left BACK three-quarter NO EYES/FACE; N pure back; NE up-right BACK three-quarter NO EYES/FACE; E right profile; SE down-right front three-quarter.
ALL sprites standing feet flat SIDE BY SIDE on same baseline, legs straight and balanced, NOT walking, NO lifted feet or crossing legs. Arms relaxed, two additional pink-black mechanical arms folded close to sides. Exact Raidian identity: short silver-gray bob, BLACK layered bird FEATHER tufts with tiny cyan/pink tips, gray jacket, narrow cyan tactical straps, black vest and skirt, bare legs, dark calf boots. TWO natural arms plus TWO mechanical arms and robotic hands. Thin charcoal electrical cord attached at back waist with clearly visible electrical two-prong PLUG hanging beside legs inside cell. NO furry tail, NO flowers, NO red/white head ornaments. Chibi oversized head consistent with reference, no realistic adult proportions. Same scale and foot baseline within each pair, tiny breathing head/shoulder dip only. Every sprite entirely inside its cell with at least 10% empty transparent gutters on all sides. True transparent background, no shadow, floor, text, visible grid, labels, glow or other characters.
